svg.title: ClarityEval score
svg.desc: ClarityEval score out of 100 for 26 systems, highest first: Claude Sonnet 5.5 with DentalClarity 94, Claude Opus 5.5 with DentalClarity 94, GLM 5.3 with DentalClarity 94, Claude Haiku 5.5 with DentalClarity 93, Tencent hy4 Flash with DentalClarity 93, DeepSeek v4.1 Flash with DentalClarity 93, GPT-6 Luna Pro with DentalClarity 92, Claude Opus 5.5 prompt only 92, MiniMax m3.1 Flash with DentalClarity 91, GPT-6 Luna with DentalClarity 91, GPT-6 Luna Pro prompt only 91, GLM 5.3 Flash with DentalClarity 90, MiMo v2.6 Flash with DentalClarity 89, Ripple 65b preview with DentalClarity 89, GPT-6 Luna prompt only 88, Claude Haiku 5.5 prompt only 88, Claude Sonnet 5.5 prompt only 88, GPT-OSS 120b with DentalClarity 85, DeepSeek v4.1 Flash prompt only 80, GLM 5.3 prompt only 80, GLM 5.3 Flash prompt only 79, Ripple 65b preview prompt only 78, Tencent hy4 Flash prompt only 77, GPT-OSS 120b prompt only 69, MiMo v2.6 Flash prompt only 68, MiniMax m3.1 Flash prompt only 54.

text.tspan: Incorporates 4 measures: presentations with no unsafe or unsupported sentence, presentations with no critical judge flag,
faithfulness to the plan, and sections shown to the patient · 36 held-out cases per system · Higher is better
